evidence.text: Therefore, since Christ suffered in His body, arm yourselves with the same resolve, because anyone who has suffered in his body is done with sin.

If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
But rejoice that you share in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed at the revelation of His glory.
If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.

evidence.text: That is why the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged as men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
For it is time for judgment to begin with the family of God; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who disobey the gospel of God?

matchReviews.senseReview: Reviewed original headword and source sense. This substantive word is admitted only where the original article explicitly cites the exact occurrence verse; ambiguous homographs and known context mismatches are separately excluded. This is selective contextual evidence, not an automatic rule for every same-spelling word.

matchReviews.senseReview: Reviewed complete original name headword and source subject. Article covers the biblical person(s), named place, or named spiritual figure denoted by this exact spelling; multiple persons under one unchanged source article remain together. Actual proper-name capitalization and whole-name boundaries required. Explicit occurrence-level ambiguity exclusions override this rule.
